0x004259e0 and 0x00401080 are dependency-only ports, and 0x0051ab50 is a dependency-only port standing in for a body that is itself excluded from this tranche

decompilation_defects_corrected: an earlier claim that the collector call is a tail call is withdrawn. 0x0051aa8d to 0x0051aa95 is the MOVZX, the PUSH, the MOV ECX and the CALL, and it is followed by the complete epilogue at 0x0051aa9a, 0x0051aa9c and 0x0051aa9d, so this is a plain call. The corrected model keeps the call in place and the epilogue after it.
the decompilation writes the six byte arguments as full words; the assembly zero-extends only the low lane, so the model stores the byte

the collector is a dependency-only port in this package because 0x0051ab50 is defective in this tranche, so the promoted body has no 0x0051ab50 code and the boundary script asserts both the absence of the body and the presence of the port
